Unused18nConfig.description: JSON options accepted by `.unused18nrc`. CLI flags override matching fields when both are set.

$schema.description: Enables editor completion and validation through the schema shipped with `unused18n`.

cache.description: Reuses persistent compiler and per-file analysis state between runs.

cacheDir.description: Overrides the persistent cache directory. Relative values resolve from `.unused18nrc`.

cacheStats.description: Prints cache hits, misses, bypasses, and reused file counts to stderr.

dictionary.description: TypeScript or strict JSON dictionary file. Relative values resolve from `.unused18nrc`.

dictionaryExport.description: Export containing a TypeScript dictionary. JSON dictionaries always use `default`.

maxExpansions.description: Positive integer limiting finite string combinations before a key becomes dynamic and advisory.

project.description: Path to `tsconfig.json` or its containing directory. Relative values resolve from `.unused18nrc`.

remove.description: Removes every unused key only when all planned dictionary edits are safe.
